summary: Support2Sim reconstructs simulation-ready scenes from a single RGB image. A support graph guides pose initialization, and short physics rollouts guide coarse-to-fine refinement. The system balances source fidelity, realization of inferred supports, and stability within bounded search budgets.

results.intro: 50 scenes across MessyKitchens, YCB-Video, Picasso, and HyperSim.
results.note: All methods are evaluated using the same reference camera, source masks, and intended-support pairs over 10 seconds. Support realization measures load-bearing object pairs in the inferred graph. FP denotes FoundationPose, and PCR denotes Physics-Constrained Real2Sim.

rollouts.description: Compare synchronized saved rollouts with the source photograph. Each method starts at release and runs for 10 seconds.
rollouts.note: Representative examples from the 50-scene evaluation. IoU and drift are averaged over the evaluated objects; support counts use the shared reference graph. PCR denotes Physics-Constrained Real2Sim.

method.description: The support graph connects perception to graph-guided seating, contact-guided pose initialization, and coarse-to-fine refinement.

image.alt: Support2Sim reconstructs the scene and support graph, constructs a contact-guided layout, and refines and validates the result.

steps.title: Reconstruct the scene
steps.description: Infer object inventories, masks, depth, geometry, and support relationships from the source image.

steps.title: Construct the layout
steps.description: Align gravity, seat supported objects, and rank contact-guided pose candidates by source-image agreement.

steps.title: Refine with rollouts
steps.description: Prioritize supported objects and evaluate pose updates at progressively finer translation and rotation scales.
